title: psm-analysis: annotated and MS2PIP mirror plots of peptide-spectrum matches for manual verification
description: psm-analysis (import package psmplot) annotates peptide-spectrum matches (PSMs) and mirrors them against MS2PIP predictions, for manual PSM verification. Each figure has three panels: a b/y fragment-coverage map, the annotated observed MS2 spectrum, and an observed-versus-MS2PIP mirror, with an optional rubric grade (excellent, good, caution, low-information). It reads MGF and mzML, handles TMT and TMTpro spectra (reporter, tag and complement ions removed before annotation and grading), and predicts spectra with MS2PIP 4, including peptides with mass-shift modifications.
